items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: Then there was one named Henry Holloway. Kildee. Kildee. Kildee. He was a member of the band. He was very good as an arranger. And we used to buy arrangements from Fats Pichon.

ctx.x: Who got the band together? Can you remember a little bit over there?

That small band? Yeah. Harry Watson was a leader. Oh, I see. He played mandolin. His brother, Eddie, played guitar. And the other brother, Henry, played banjoe. And this old man, Murray, played bass. And I can just a string of them. And we played for various entertainers, which was very nice.
Do you remember, when did you join Papa Subtame Band?
